messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — PO publish failed for AcmeCloud marketplace deal. Portal returned a billing account mismatch when we tried to publish the PO. @Devin can you take a look? marketplace-bot pasted the error below.

marketplace-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: PO publish_failed for PO-89421
```
marketplace.publish.fail {
  "po_id": "PO-89421",
  "error": "billing_entity_mismatch",
  "portal_response": "Vendor not found for billing_account 98765"
}
```

Devin Lee: Got it — thanks Samir. Is PO-89421 tied to the old Acme legal entity or the new one? Also need the portal vendor_id if you have it.

Samir Patel: Customer signed the SOW with Acme Systems, billing entity acme-sys-llc (new). The portal vendor was created under acme-legacy (id: vendor_4532). Looks like mismatch.

Anita Gomez: This is the classic billing-entity alias problem we saw in Q4. Marketplace portal expects vendor.billing_account to match the PO.buyer_billing_id. If vendor was created under legacy account we either need an alias or repoint PO to the legacy billing account.

Gabe Ortiz: Short-term workaround: create a vendor alias mapping in the marketplace portal so vendor_4532 -> acme-sys-llc, then re-publish. Long-term: update vendor record and sync with procurement. I'll open a support ticket.

Devin Lee: For the workaround — can you confirm steps? I can run them if it's just portal UI, otherwise I need a support ticket. Customer needs this today.

Gabe Ortiz: Steps: 
1) Marketplace Admin -> Vendors -> Search vendor_4532 -> Edit aliases
2) Add alias billing_account: acme-sys-llc -> save
3) Re-run PO publish (console -> Orders -> PO-89421 -> Publish)

If the alias UI is blocked, I'll escalate to marketplace support.

Anita Gomez: Also ping Contracts — there's a small SOW billing redline we missed that allowed them to pay from either entity. If legal hasn't signed off, we should avoid creating permanent alias until contracts confirms. Temporary alias + support ticket is fine.

Samir Patel: Noted. I'll hold customer comms until we have a ticket. Please copy me on the support ticket and Contracts. ETA today EOD would be ideal. :thumbsup:

Gabe Ortiz: Opening ticket now and CCing Contracts. Ticket created: https://support.marketplace.example/tickets/MKP-4528 — assigned to marketplace-ops. CC: contracts@redwood.

marketplace-bot: Ticket MKP-4528 status: CREATED (assigned marketplace-ops)

Devin Lee: I'll try the alias steps first. If UI blocked, I'll ask marketplace-ops to apply alias and then re-publish. Keeping Samir updated.

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. Please update this thread when PO publishes or if legal flags the alias.

Gabe Ortiz: Will do — will post back once MKP-4528 has progress.

Anita Gomez: Adding note for future: create pre-check in our marketplace onboarding checklist to verify vendor.billing_entity == customer.billing_entity to avoid this class of failure.

Samir Patel: Good call. Filing a follow-up action in internal tracker after this resolves.
